notes.title: 20250620 Bug Fix
notes.content:
Bug Fixed:
[list]
[*]The issue where pressing the Enter key in training mode would accidentally trigger the last key pressed on the numeric keypad has been fixed (the Unity button's built-in auto function really tripped me up!).
[*]The problem that the green button could not be clicked with a mouse in challenge mode has been resolved.
[/list]

Thanks for the player yhwhloveu who find the bug~

notes.title: 20240419 Little update
notes.content:
In response to the needs of some players, the game has now supported the small keyboard.
Ah, for now only the challenge mode and training mode support the small keyboard, the little "boom" game at the start of the game hasn't support yet///(I just found it, sooorrrry)
Next time, definitely!

The Quarterly Challenge mode is 50% complete, although it is a small feature but stay tuned ~

Have fun with your arithmetic

notes.title: 20231215 little update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, a small bug has been fixed

In previous versions, there were no restrictions on the button activation logic of the Challenge mode small keyboard. As a result, you can pass all challenges without answering any question

This bug has now been fixed ~

ps, I just successfully passed all changes, the difficulty will be increased quickly ~ Keep up the good work, my friends, if you want to get all the achievements!
